scope: Every new Phase 4.6-4.10 module's reproducibility/versioning metadata

checks_performed.has_full_manifest: ModelManifest.as_dict() records model_id, model_revision, source, tokenizer_id, device, precision, seed, torch/transformers/python versions, platform

checks_performed.has_corpus_version: corpus_version field in data/real_model_tasks/*.json, generated by a versioned, seeded, deterministic script

checks_performed.decision_provenance: AgentAutonomyDecision.policy_version travels with every decision object; RetryDisabledCalibrationProfile (Phase 4.10) appends '+retry-disabled' to the version string rather than silently reusing the base profile's version

checks_performed.has_version_constant: FEATURE_NAMES_V2 explicitly documents which feature was added and why

checks_performed.full_metadata: EnvironmentProfile.as_dict() records environment_id, role, resource_limits, runtime_config_kwargs, dependency_conditions, telemetry_capabilities, failure_mechanisms, environment_version for all three environments

verdict: Every new module carries an explicit version constant and every produced artifact (predictions, decisions, evaluation reports) records which version produced it. No unversioned code path was found among the Phase 4.6-4.10 additions.
